name: Togal.AI
summary: AI takeoff that automates area and length measurement from drawings for multiple trades.
differentiator: List price matches STACK's takeoff tier ($299 per user per month, billed yearly) but includes unlimited automated takeoffs, and there is no free version or trial: you book a demo first. Trades named on its site range from painting, drywall and flooring to electrical and framing.
pricing: Growth is $299 per user per month billed yearly. Business plan is custom for teams of four or more. No free trial; access starts with a demo.
entryPrice: $299 per user per month, billed yearly
bestFor: High-volume estimators in finish trades who want measurement automated.
skipIf: You want to try it on a live bid before paying.
